# Git Commit Guidelines

When generating commit messages for this repository, you MUST use the following Conventional Commits prefixes:

-   Use `feat:` for new features (e.g., "feat: add osu! hit-sound support")
-   Use `fix:` for bug fixes (e.g., "fix: resolve crash on startup")
-   Use `major:` for breaking changes or total rewrites (e.g., "major: upgrade to .NET 9 and new UI")

Always start the message with one of these lowercase prefixes followed by a colon and a space. Keep the description short and in the imperative mood (e.g., "add" instead of "added").
